title: PROPOSED gap criteria list
description: Design-only list transcribed from the DK-500e-2 delivers_to contract (docs/acceptance-criteria/decision-kernel/DK-500-reusable-decision-criteria/DK-500e-2.yaml): criteria drafted only for the concerns the gap verdict names, proposed beside the reused criteria. DK-500e-2 names removed_repeats beside this list but defines no enclosing payload, so that list is not part of this schema. No kernel step, host response or validator implements this list yet; it is not a kernel Criterion, which forbids extra fields such as gap_concern.

wording.description: the drafted question; it never repeats the wording of a reused criterion

criterion_id.description: the drafted criterion's id within the decision

gap_concern.description: the missing concern from the gap verdict that this criterion addresses; the kernel drops criteria naming no such concern

proposal_status.description: always proposed: drafted criteria stay proposals until approved
